$comment: The cyberpunk skin's only art (README.md, "Art"): eleven white sprites with alpha that python3 tools/nui_skin_art.py build draws from these numbers (1x pixels) into cyberpunk-1x.png, cyberpunk-2x.png and cyberpunk-sprites.rcss. RCSS rounds corners only, and a 45-degree cut corner on a box of any size would cost two nested mask layers per element per frame; a ninepatch of white art tinted by image-color draws it as one cached decorator in the player's colors. The shapes are the reviewed mockup's (stage 2): frames cut 12px at the top right and bottom left, buttons and chips 7px at the bottom right, HUD boards 6px at the top left and bottom right, the toggle a slanted track and knob. A circular progress bar draws its fill only from an image (fill-image), so the taskbar's HP ring takes the ring sprite.
